acceptance_rule: Positive control must pass all three detector-dependent metrics; every negative control must fail at least one.

positive_driving_60f.description: PR-VID-184 frozen retrimmed driving clip itself (2.30-4.80s window of Mixkit #583), not a generated output -- the ground-truth locomotion signal.

negative_vid181_locomotion.description: PR-VID-181 accepted Case B (locomotion) Animate v1 output: ANIMATE_REAL_POSE_LOCAL_MOTION_ONLY -- documented planted reference subject plus a separate moving ghost figure.

negative_vid183_A.description: PR-VID-183 accepted Arm A output: BASIC_RETARGET_APPLIES; REFERENCE_BOUND_LOCOMOTION_NOT_DEMONSTRATED -- documented distorted/non-translating figure.

negative_vid183_B.description: PR-VID-183 accepted Arm B output: same classification -- documented cropped lower-body/exaggerated split-step, not stable reference-bound walking.

detector_json_note: Per-case raw detector JSON (person boxes per frame) and the retrimmed/output MP4 files live in the disposable qual workspace, not committed; this file is the reviewable committed evidence (hashes, scored metric values, pass/fail against the frozen contract).

local_candidate_envelope_comparison.purpose: Revise the run-5 local-candidate frame count (owner correction 2026-09-26): the original 13-frame hypothesis carried over v1 proven-safe FRAME COUNT without correcting for frame rate (v1 ran at 8fps = 1.625s; our clip is native 24fps). Compares the original 13-frame candidate against a revised 39-frame candidate (39 = round(1.625s * 24fps)), both obtained by truncating the same approved 60-frame driving file -- no new asset.

candidate_13f.note: Barely clears the 0.15 pass gate; materially shorter than the accepted PR-VID-183 1.625s locomotion-window standard.

candidate_39f.note: Exactly matches the accepted PR-VID-183 1.625s locomotion-window standard at native 24fps (no resampling). Visually confirmed (full contact sheet) to contain clear alternating left/right stride progression throughout, subject fully in frame. 3.1x the root_translation_fraction of the 13-frame candidate. SELECTED as the revised run-5 local-candidate envelope.

local_candidate_envelope_comparison.conclusion: This measures the DRIVING-VIDEO INPUT only (motion content of the candidate envelope), not Wan-Animate-2 model output behavior -- no GPU/cloud run was performed. It resolves which candidate to feed the model, not what the model will do with it.
